name: INEMA Amber
tagline: INEMA's dark premium amber: navy-black, bone type, amber keyword, Anton hooks, karaoke 1–3 words, pattern interrupts.

motion.direction: INEMA `viral` / `acao`. Anton 900 hooks at 88–110 px, titles in a clean sans 48–72, mono kickers (JetBrains Mono 18–22, tracking 3 px, uppercase), karaoke captions 1–3 words at a time (~280 ms per word) with the keyword in amber `ter` or on a teal `goldd` box; `number pop` back.out(2); a 5 px rule from amber to orange `gold` under titles; hero push 1.05 + 12 % over the beat. Cuts 0.8–1.5 s (viral) with whips and punch-zooms; a pattern interrupt every 3–5 s; `power2.in` exits (dive). Hook 0–3 s high energy → value with interrupts → peak before the CTA (amber with glow). Grain .08, halation vignette.
